evals.prompt: Help me turn this into a proper user story: implement 404 handling for PDP routes, rules should match AEM
evals.expected_output: Full pipeline run with turn labels, NEEDS_HUMAN for AEM rules, final APPROVED STORY block with concrete 404 conditions

assertions.text: Story follows As a / I want / so that format
Pipeline labels [STORY WRITER] and [TECH LEAD] present
AEM 404 conditions defined concretely (invalid SKU / unpublished / out-of-market)
No invented conditions added beyond the three stated (no 'deleted', 'archived', etc.)
Happy-path criterion uses plain generic language, not invented jargon like 'in-market product'

evals.prompt: Refine this story: As a shopper I want to search for products so that I can find things to buy
evals.expected_output: Refined story with specific acceptance criteria, INVEST note, story points, no Given/When/Then

assertions.text: Story follows As a / I want / so that format
Acceptance criteria more specific than the original vague story

evals.prompt: Write a user story for: add rate limiting to the public API
evals.expected_output: Story with concrete rate limit thresholds, 429 status, INVEST note, story points, no Given/When/Then

assertions.text: Story follows As a / I want / so that format
Acceptance criteria specify concrete rate limit threshold or surface it as an Open Question
